mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) inhibits CYP3A4 and may enhance dexamethasone levels; additionally, turmeric has anticoagulant and antiplatelet properties that could potentiate corticosteroid-induced immunosuppression and bleeding risk.
action: Monitor for increased corticosteroid side effects and bleeding signs; consider separating administration times; advise patients to report unusual bleeding or infection; consult with prescriber before concurrent use.
